name: Taylor
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Taylor for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events. The magic runs from November 27 (Santa's Magic Forest at Eureka Heights Elementary) through December 23 (the Taylor Winterfest Stroll), with the Taylor Winterfest on December 5 and the Jingle Bell Barn on December 12 and 13 along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Taylor

  • 4 Christmas events for Taylor families
  • Meet Santa: Santa and Mrs. Claus at Santa's Magic Forest, weekends November 27 to December 20
  • Lights: Winterfest Stroll through Heritage Park holiday lights
  • Animals: Jingle Bell Barn at the Heritage Park Petting Farm
  • Season: November 27 to December 23, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? Taylor families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Detroit, which covers the Detroit Symphony, Winter Wonders at Hudson's Detroit and Holiday Nights in Greenfield Village.
